name: Included with Outpost
description: Reference sheets written for Outpost and shipped with it. Adding one copies it into the document library; nothing is downloaded.

entries.name: Amateur radio bands in the United Kingdom
entries.description: Every band in the Ofcom amateur radio licence, with status and power limits for the Foundation, Intermediate and Full licences, the 5 MHz segments, and the usual calling frequencies.
entries.licenseNote: An original compilation of facts from the official sources listed at the end of the sheet, checked on the date shown there. It is not an official document and not legal advice: rules change, so confirm with the source before relying on a figure.
entries.attribution: Compiled for Outpost from the regulators and bodies named in the sheet's list of sources.
